response.reason: The Abramowitz–Stegun 7.1.26 approximation has absolute erfc error up to ~1.5e-7, so the error in Phi (~7.5e-8) multiplied by x can reach ~1e-3–1e-2 for large inputs (e.g. x = 65504, GELU ≈ x), far exceeding the required absolute tolerance of 1e-6.
